Job Title: AI / GenAI Engineer




Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad




Experience: 5+ Years




Job Summary




We are looking for an AI/GenAI Engineer with expertise in building GenAI applications, AI agents, backend development, ServiceNow automation, and cloud platforms.




Mandatory Skills

Agentic AI & LLMs: LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, AutoGen

Python Backend: Python, FastAPI, Flask, Pydantic, Pytest, REST APIs

ServiceNow & Automation: Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Now Assist, REST API Integrations

Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS/Azure, Vault




Responsibilities

Develop and deploy GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Build scalable Python-based APIs and microservices.
Integrate AI solutions with ServiceNow workflows.
Implement cloud-native architectures and CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver enterprise AI solutions.
